$comment: Cosmo's first move for a spoken request (scripts/eval-voice.ts). One turn each: the model gets the real Cosmo prompt for a seeded user and must reach for one of `tools` first (any of them), never any of `notTools`, or no tool at all when `noTool`. `inputIncludes` must appear in that call's arguments. Screens are what Cosmo is told about the page (src/lib/cosmo/screen.ts). Ada Lovelace and Grace Hopper are seeded contacts.
